title: Take customer orders in Messenger with an agent
summary: An automation builder made an n8n agent that reads Messenger orders, checks inventory, logs the sale, emails the order, alerts Slack and replies to the customer.
agent_role: The agent handles each incoming message end to end: stock check, sale record, order email, team alert and customer reply. The human builds the workflow.
outcome: Author shows the flow running in a video.
what_they_did: The poster built an agent in n8n, a tool for linking apps into automatic workflows. When a customer messages on Messenger, the agent checks inventory and logs the sale. It then emails the order, posts a note in Slack and replies to the customer.
how_it_went: The author says it runs automatically and shares a video demo.
worth_knowing: The template is only offered to people who comment on the post. The post gives no build details.
prompt: Help me build an n8n workflow for my shop. When a customer sends an order on Messenger, check stock in [your inventory sheet] and log the sale. Email the order to [your email] and post a note in [Slack channel]. Then draft a reply to the customer. Show me the workflow and test it on a sample message before turning it on.

curation.rationale: A concrete small-business order flow in n8n with a video demo, though the post is short and mostly asks people to comment for a template.
